title.original: CoDec: Prefix-Shared Decoding Kernel for LLMs
title.en: CoDec: Prefix-Shared Decoding Kernel for LLMs

inclusion_reason.zh: CoDec 把共享前缀分析、KV 合并访问、专用 kernel 和不规则负载调度组合为可部署的解码执行组件。
inclusion_reason.en: CoDec combines shared-prefix analysis, merged KV access, a specialized kernel, and irregular-work scheduling into a deployable decode-execution component.

abstract.zh: CoDec 是面向多请求共享前缀场景的解码注意力内核，把共同前缀的 KV 读取合并，并为树形依赖设计跨线程块并行与负载均衡。
abstract.en: CoDec is a decode-attention kernel for requests with shared prefixes, combining common KV reads and adding inter-block parallelism plus load balancing for tree-structured dependencies.

problem.zh: 长上下文解码受 KV 缓存带宽限制；即使多个请求共享前缀，常规内核仍重复读取，而树形前缀又带来不规则任务和依赖。
problem.en: Long-context decoding is KV-bandwidth bound; conventional kernels reload identical shared prefixes, while the prefix tree creates irregular work and dependencies.

approach.zh: 内核重排共享前缀的内存层次和访问顺序，同时利用块内与块间并行；成本估计器对不规则树任务切分和调度。
approach.en: The kernel reorganizes memory hierarchy and access order for shared prefixes, exploits intra- and inter-block parallelism, and uses a cost estimator to partition and schedule irregular tree work.

system_design.zh: 前缀树首先生成共享 KV 分组，任务划分器估算各节点开销，专用注意力 kernel 合并读取并行计算，归并阶段组合每个请求的结果。
system_design.en: A prefix tree yields shared-KV groups, a partitioner estimates node costs, the specialized attention kernel computes with merged reads, and a merge stage produces per-request outputs.

key_results.zh: 与通用解码注意力实现相比，CoDec 显著减少共享前缀的内存访问并降低注意力与单 token 端到端时延。
key_results.en: Compared with general decode-attention implementations, CoDec substantially reduces shared-prefix memory traffic and lowers both attention and end-to-end per-token latency.

limitations.zh: 收益依赖请求间存在足够长的共享前缀；前缀树维护、动态批处理和短上下文可能抵消内核优势，结果也主要针对特定 GPU。
limitations.en: Benefits require sufficiently long shared prefixes; tree maintenance, dynamic batching, and short contexts can offset gains, and evidence is tied mainly to specific GPUs.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
